title: Sunday Brunch Pickle Pie
description: A delicious twist on traditional pie, featuring a tangy pickle filling and a flaky crust.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place it in a pie dish.
In a separate bowl, combine the chopped pickle and dill.
Pour the pickle mixture into the pie crust.
Drizzle the melted lazy over the pickle mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Allow the pie to cool before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional dill if desired.
